2. The prosecution case, in brief, is that on 11.2.1991 immediately after the evening after completion of their meal the informant Nikhil Chandra Halder along with his wife went to sleep in the first floor of their two storied dwelling but built with leaves and straws. His old mother and father were lying in the southern corridor of the ground floor of the house. In response to the call of nature he having come down from the first floor went to the latrine on the southern side of the house. When the lamp was lighting in the first floor he asked his wife to close the door. At the time of going out he saw that his father was sleeping under a mosquito net in the western side of the southern corridor of the ground floor and his mother was smashing "pan" sitting near the bed of his father in the light of a lamp. On return from the latrine at about 7.00 pm while he reached in the middle of the yard he saw that 3/4 persons focusing torch light ran into his house through the open door. His two barreled gun was kept in the almirah on the first floor of the house and for this reason he ran into the house and saw that one person was climbing through the stairs to the floor of the house. The informant tried to go to the first floor but he was prevented by two dacoits on the ground floor by pulling his lungi. The dacoits who went to the first floor asked his wife about the gun and threatened her to disclose where about of the gun, otherwise she would be killed. Being frightened his wife disclosed that the gun was lying on the almirah. The said dacoits brought out the gun from almirah. Finding no other alternative the in formant while going to the first floor got his lungi dropped from his body and in a naked condition he went to the 1st floor and chased the dacoits with the gun and tried to take back the said gun. At that time the dacoits raised alarm and asked their companions to come to the first floor for his rescue. Then the other two dacoits went to the 1st floor and one of them dealt a knife blow in the chest of the informant which was obstructed by his left hand causing bleeding injury in his palm. These two dacoits forcibly made him to get out of the house focusing torch light on his eyes and the remaining two dacoits having broken the locks of the two trunks and from the bed took away cartridges of gun and articles. They also snatched one pair of gold ear rings from the ears of the wife of the informant. At that time his wife came down taking his infant child in her arm. After a short while the dacoits from the l' floor came down. When the dacoits from the first floor were coming down the informant snatched a red gamcha which was fastened on the head of one Of the dacoits. Then the dacoits having come down to the ground floor broke the boxes of his father and mother. The informant raised alarm and one of the dacoits being annoyed threatened him to stop. The informant having opened the window of the first floor went out towards the west raising alarm. Hearing the alarm the local residents namely Bimal Chakraborty, Sharat Mandal, Kartik, brother of the informant, Sunil, armed with gun came along with Harshit Tapali Chairman Keramot and many other people to the place of occurrence and at that time the dacoits were chased from the back and they fled away towards eastern side of the house in the field. On query by the local people his mother stated that apart from the three dacoits who went to the floor there were 2/3 dacoits standing on the ground floor but she could not recognize them. The informant's father stated that hearing the alarm of informant's mother he woke up and sat on the bed inside the mosquito net. One of the dacoits struck him with a stick. Then he fled away towards the western side corridor of the house. Hearing hue and cry when the informant's brother Sunil neighbour Kartik and Sharat came to the place of occurrence, one of the dacoits struck them with stick causing injury in the left hand of Sunil and being chased they went away towards the western side Hearing hue and cry his neighbour Bimal Chakraborty wanted to come out of his house but he was also prevented by two dacoits stating that they would kill him if he would come out from the house. Hearing this he fled away passing through the western side of the garden. Nirmal also stated that he saw 8/10 dacoits on the road who tied him on the road and then 3/4 dacoits entered into the house of the informant keeping the said Nirmal tied up with a pillar of the corridor. Nirmal managed to flee away. The accused persons were aged between 20 to 35 years and they used to speak in local dialect. Out of the three dacoits those who went to the floor the informant recognized the accused persons by the light of the lamp. The dacoits looted away one old two barrel gun being No. 50343 worth of Tk. 23,000/-,40 cartridges, out of which 25 were selar bullets, 8 Eli Highmax LG, 5 Tiger, 5 Rubent, and 7 plastic worth of Tk. 1,000/- and cash money of Tk. 3000/-, a pair of gold ear rings weighing 4 arias worth of Tk. 1500/-, one woolen Shawl worth of Tk. 450/-, one lady's watch worth of Tk.1000/- and old lungi worth of Tk.50/-, in total articles worth of Tk. 30,000/- were looted by the dacoits. When the informant called his father and mother on the first floor one of the dacoits struck below the knee joint of the informant by the rough side of ramdao causing injury. Nirmol stated that when he was tied up by the dacoits he also saw one of the dacoits to carry a gun and each of them was carrying a torch light in their hands. The informant having obtained medical treatment went to the Police Station for lodging an ejahar. Accordingly, Rampal Police Station Case No. 3 dated 12.2.1991 under section 395/397 of the Penal Code was started. It is stated that the accused appellants made confessional statements under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Morelganj Police Station Case No. 8 dated 11.2.1991. The Photostat copy of the aforesaid confessional statements before the Magistrate was produced on 1.7.1991 which was kept with the record. It is stated that in the said confessional statement they admitted as to their complicity in the commission of the dacoity with arms in the house of the informant on the date of occurrence. The police after investigation submitted charge sheet against the accused persons including the accused appellants under section 395 and 397 of the Penal Code. 

 8. The informant Nikhil Chandra Haider as PW1 in examination-in-chief stated that on 11.2.1991 at 7.00/7.30 pm he went to toilet in response to a natural call. When he was returning to the house he saw that 4/5 persons were focusing their torch lights in the yard and then entered into their house and at that time he also entered into his house following two dacoits who had entered immediately before him. He followed them. There were two dacoits behind him. When the informant pushed one of the two dacoits he fell down. The dacoits went to the 1st floor when the informant was going there by climbing through the stair case two dacoits pulled his lungi from the back and he saw that the dacoits who went to the 1st floor having broken the lock entered into the room. Because of pulling of the lungi by the dacoits the lungi was dropped and he went to the 1st floor in the naked condition and chased the dacoits who went to the 1st floor and took out a gun from inside the almirah. The said dacoit called his companion dacoits to come to the 1st floor to rescue him as he was caught by the informant. Hearing his cries the other two dacoits went to the 1st floor and when the accused persons struck a knife blow the informant leaving the earlier dacoits resisted the blow by his left hand and thereby suffered bleeding injuries in his palm. One accused person armed with a gun went on the khat and other accused persons focused torch light on the eyes of the informant and wanted to strike him with knife. Having failed to do so he kicked 8/10 times with his legs on the informant. The dacoit who was sitting on the back having jumped near the trunks and suitcases broke the lock and the said dacoit struck with rough/blunt side of the ramdao below the knee joint of the left leg of the informant. At that time the dacoits took 25 saila Selar bullet, 8 toli two LG, 5 Tiger, 5 Robat, 7 Plastic cartridges, worth of Tk. 1000/- and cash money amounting to Tk. 3000/- in total Tk. 30,000/- was looted by the dacoits. The looted articles included gold ear rings of the wife of the informant. One dacoit was standing 7/8 seconds near the informant when he snatched a red gamcha from the head of the said dacoit. When the dacoits were damaging and coming down the stairs the informant raised alarm and his wife also got down to the ground floor with the dacoits. The informant went out through an open door and fled away towards the western side when the accused persons threatened him. Thus he went to his brother. Thereafter his nephew Sattar also came to the place of occurrence when the accused appellants made two rounds of blank fire, and at that time Harashi Tapali and Chairman along with 200/100 people came to place of occurrence. He disclosed to them the occurrence on the next day at 12.00 noon and lodged an ejahar with Rampal Police Station. He proved the ejahar which was marked as Ext.1 and his signature there in was marked as Ext.1/1. The Daroga seized the articles in his presence and prepared Jimmanama which was marked as Ext.2 and his signature therein was marked as Ext.2/1. He heard that his gun was recovered which was lying in the Morelganj Police Station. In cross-examination he stated that he lodged an ejahar after the dacoity in his house and noted that the age of the accused was about 45 years. 

 14. Abdus Sattar as PW7 deposed that on 23.3.1991 when he was attached to Morelganj Police Station he arrested the accused appellants in connection with Morelganj Police Station Case No.8 dated 11.2.1991. According to their confessional statements and at the showing of the accused appellants one double barrel gun made in Spain, one country made one barrel gun were recovered from the house of Ismail Mridha. He stated that in respect of those arms and ammunitions Morelganj Police Station Case No. 5 dated 24.3.1991 under section 395 and Morelganj Police Station Case No. 3 dated 12.2.1991 under section 395/397 was started. He also deposed that alamot No. 1 of the aforesaid alamots was the gun of Anil Chandra, informant of Morelganj Police Station Case No.3 dated 12.2.1991 under section 395/397 of the Penal Code. In cross-examination he stated that the recovered arms were not produced before the Court on that date. In cross-examination he stated that at the time of arresting the accused persons he along with Officer-in-Charge Faisal, Abdul Mannan, Matiar Rahman, Abdul Sabur, and Sultan Ahmed went there to arrest the accused persons. In cross-examination he further stated that none of the local people was present at the time of arrest. He could not remember when they arrested the accused persons.
